children: appointed Jill Albertelli as president of its Pratt & Whitney business, effective January 1.

Albertelli will report to RTX Chairman and CEO Chris Calio. She will succeed Shane Eddy, who plans to retire after more than 40 years with the company. Eddy will remain through March 2027 as a special adviser to assist with the transition.

Albertelli most recently led Pratt & Whitney’s Military Engines division. During her tenure, the company retained its position as the sole-source propulsion provider for the F-35 fighter jet, improved delivery and quality performance for the F135 engine and expanded its military-engine maintenance capacity.
Her three decades at Pratt & Whitney also have included roles in engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply-chain management, commercial programs, sales and strategy.
Eddy became president in 2022 and oversaw Pratt & Whitney’s continuing transformation, including production and maintenance expansion for its Geared Turbofan and F135 engine programs.

title: RTX names Jill Albertelli president of Pratt & Whitney as Shane Eddy retires
